title: Pay Point India Becomes 1st Private Fintech Member of RBI Centralised Payment System (CPS)
summary: Pay Point India Network obtains direct access to RTGS and NEFT systems with its own IFSC code, removing bank intermediary dependencies.

blocks.text: 🪝 Pay Point India Becomes 1st Private Fintech Member of RBI Centralised Payment System (CPS). Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: **Pay Point India Network** became the first private-sector non-bank fintech to gain direct membership in RBI's Centralised Payment System (CPS), granting it direct RTGS and NEFT connectivity.
